NicolasStigler opened PR #15179 from NicolasStigler:main to bytecodealliance:main:

Fixes #3296

Why

The x64 backend had no lowering for ssub_sat on i32x4 or i64x2. Since x86 has no packed signed saturating-subtraction instruction for those lane widths and there was no legalization fallback, these operations failed with an ISLE lowering error.

What changed

  • Add SSE2-based lowerings for i32x4 and i64x2 signed saturating subtraction.
  • Detect subtraction overflow per lane and select the appropriate MIN or MAX saturation value.
  • Update x64 fuzzgen so it no longer excludes ssub_sat for these types.
  • Extend and rename the regression test to cover AArch64, x86_64, x86_64 with AVX, and both RISC-V 64-bit configurations.

Testing

  • cargo +1.97.0 fmt --all -- --check
  • cargo +1.97.0 test -p cranelift-codegen
  • cargo +1.97.0 test -p cranelift-filetests
  • cargo +1.97.0 test -p cranelift-tools --test filetests
  • cargo +1.97.0 test -p cranelift-tools --test logged-filetests
  • cargo +1.97.0 check -p cranelift-fuzzgen
  • Ran the regression test, both x64 reproducers, and the original multi-target reproducer with clif-util; all passed.
  • Confirmed the x64 lowerings use SSE2 instructions. x64 runtests ran natively; AArch64, RISC-V 64-bit, and s390x targets were compile-only.
